definitions.malformed_payload: The artifact JSON did not load to a top-level object.
definitions.missing_required_field: A required top-level artifact field is absent.
definitions.nonterminal_artifact: The shared terminal classifier did not find a terminal state.
definitions.missing_terminal_prefix: honest_verdict does not start with an accepted terminal prefix.
definitions.field_principles_not_mapping: field_principles is absent or not an object.
definitions.field_provenance_not_mapping: field_provenance is absent or not an object.
definitions.missing_field_principle: A required field has no field_principles entry.
definitions.missing_field_provenance: A required field has no field_provenance entry.
definitions.unknown_compute_bound_substrate: A compute-bound artifact used an unknown substrate name.
definitions.duration_missing: duration_s is absent or not a finite number.
definitions.duration_floor_violation: duration_s is below the selected substrate duration floor.
definitions.methodology_missing: Compute-bound evidence is missing model, seed, or checksum receipts.
definitions.reproducibility_missing: A seed, checksum, or precondition receipt is absent.
definitions.test_commands_missing: test_commands is absent, empty, or not a list of strings.
definitions.test_exit_codes_not_mapping: test_exit_codes is absent or not an object.
definitions.test_exit_code_missing: A declared test command has no recorded exit code.
definitions.test_exit_code_extra: An exit-code entry names a command not declared in test_commands.
definitions.test_exit_code_not_int: A recorded exit code is not a bare integer.
definitions.test_exit_code_nonzero: A recorded test command exited nonzero.
definitions.gate_field_nonterminal_artifact: A staged gate points at a nonterminal artifact.
definitions.gate_field_missing: A staged gate field is absent at the top level.
definitions.gate_field_not_bare: A staged gate field is principle-wrapped rather than bare.
definitions.gate_field_type_mismatch: A staged gate field has the wrong bare value type.
definitions.determination_dropped: A protected determination or review marker was dropped.

status.principle: The report closes only after fixture replay and protected hashes pass.

failure_taxonomy.principle: Stable class names make each rejection auditable.

source_paths_and_hashes.principle: Source hashes bind the linter to the exact code and inputs.

synthetic_fixture_manifest_path_and_hash.principle: Synthetic fixtures need a stable manifest.

required_field_checks.principle: Missing fields are the cheapest fabrication signal.

terminal_prefix_checks.principle: A terminal prefix prevents partial verdict laundering.

field_principle_coverage_checks.principle: Each required field must carry the reason it exists.

substrate_duration_and_methodology_check.principle: Compute claims need plausible time and receipts.

test_command_and_exit_code_checks.principle: Recorded verification failures must stay visible.

gate_field_type_checks.principle: Gates must read exact bare values of the expected type.

determination_preservation_checks.principle: Review determinations must not silently disappear.

clean_fixture_accept_count.principle: The linter must accept known-good terminal evidence.

bad_fixture_reject_count.principle: The linter must reject known-bad terminal evidence.

false_accept_count.principle: Bare zero proves bad fixtures did not pass.

false_reject_count.principle: Bare zero proves the clean fixture did not fail.

cli_contract.principle: The CLI must be reproducible and separate from the conductor.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: Protected hashes prove this run did not rewrite inputs.

preconditions_checked.principle: The run records git state, hashes, and fixture setup first.

inference_substrate.principle: This task runs artifact QA lint tests, not model inference.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The linter checks evidence quality and is not an answer oracle.

field_provenance.principle: Every required field cites the evidence source that produced it.

field_principles.principle: Every required field states the guard principle it serves.

test_commands.principle: The report lists the bounded project-owned verification commands.

test_exit_codes.principle: The report preserves exit codes without converting failures to passes.

duration_s.principle: Wall time records the QA cost without padding.

random_seed.principle: A fixed seed makes the synthetic fixture manifest reproducible.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A normalized checksum detects silent payload drift.

terminal_evidence_preflight_ready_score.principle: The score is one only with zero false counts.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict states the terminal result with a safe prefix.
